plugin.name: ShatteredRealms_GMCP
plugin.author: Shattered Realms
plugin.purpose: Health, mana and enemy bars from GMCP
plugin.description: Shows health, mana and your enemy's health in a movable window, using the GMCP data sent by Shattered Realms. Drag the window by its title strip to move it.

muclient.script:
require "json" require "movewindow"
local GMCP = 201 local WIN = "sr_gmcp_" .. GetPluginID() local W, H, TITLE = 260, 86, 14 local FONT = "f"
-- No moves bar: the server intentionally never sends moves. local st = { hp = 0, mana = 0, maxhp = 1, maxmana = 1, enemy = "", enemypct = 0 } -- false until the first GMCP message arrives. GMCP is only switched on when -- MUSHclient connects with this plugin already installed. local got_data = false local mwin = nil
local function send_gmcp(msg) SendPkt("\255\250" .. string.char(GMCP) .. msg .. "\255\240") end
local function clamp(v, lo, hi) if v < lo then return lo end if v > hi then return hi end return v end
local function bar(y, label, cur, max, fill, back) local x1, x2, h = 4, W - 4, 16 WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, x1, y, x2, y + h, back) -- background local frac = 0 if max > 0 then frac = clamp(cur / max, 0, 1) end local fx = x1 + math.floor((x2 - x1) * frac) if fx > x1 then WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, x1, y, fx, y + h, fill) end WindowRectOp(WIN, 1, x1, y, x2, y + h, 0x808080) -- frame WindowText(WIN, FONT, label, x1 + 4, y + 2, x2 - 2, y + h, 0xFFFFFF, false) end
local function redraw() if not mwin then return end WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, 0, 0, W, H, 0x201818) -- window background WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, 0, 0, W, TITLE, 0x504040) -- drag strip WindowText(WIN, FONT, "Shattered Realms", 4, 1, W, TITLE, 0xFFFFFF, false) -- colours are BGR in MUSHclient bar(TITLE + 4, string.format("HP %d / %d", st.hp, st.maxhp), st.hp, st.maxhp, 0x1E1EC8, 0x07073A) bar(TITLE + 24, string.format("Mana %d / %d", st.mana, st.maxmana), st.mana, st.maxmana, 0xDC5028, 0x3A1408) if not got_data then WindowText(WIN, FONT, "No data yet: disconnect and reconnect", 4, TITLE + 46, W, H, 0x00FFFF, false) elseif st.enemy ~= "" then bar(TITLE + 44, string.format("%s %d%%", st.enemy, st.enemypct), st.enemypct, 100, 0x1478C8, 0x052038) end WindowShow(WIN, true) end
function OnPluginInstall() mwin = movewindow.install(WIN, 6, 0) WindowCreate(WIN, mwin.window_left, mwin.window_top, W, H, mwin.window_mode, mwin.window_flags, 0x000000) WindowFont(WIN, FONT, "Fixedsys", 9, false, false, false, false) movewindow.add_drag_handler(WIN, 0, 0, 0, TITLE) redraw() if IsConnected() then ColourNote("yellow", "", "Shattered Realms bars installed. Disconnect and " .. "reconnect to start them (GMCP is only switched on at connect).") end end
function OnPluginSaveState() if mwin then movewindow.save_state(WIN) end end
function OnPluginClose() WindowDelete(WIN) end
function OnPluginDisable() WindowShow(WIN, false) end
function OnPluginEnable() redraw() end
function OnPluginTelnetRequest(msg_type, data) if msg_type ~= GMCP then return false end if data == "WILL" then return true -- yes, we want GMCP elseif data == "SENT_DO" then send_gmcp('Core.Hello { "client": "MUSHclient", "version": "' .. Version() .. '" }') send_gmcp('Core.Supports.Set [ "Char 1", "Room 1" ]') return true end return false end
local handlers = {}
handlers["char.vitals"] = function(t) st.hp = tonumber(t.hp) or st.hp st.mana = tonumber(t.mana) or st.mana end
handlers["char.maxstats"] = function(t) st.maxhp = tonumber(t.maxhp) or st.maxhp st.maxmana = tonumber(t.maxmana) or st.maxmana end
handlers["char.status"] = function(t) st.enemy = t.enemy or "" st.enemypct = tonumber(t.enemypct) or 0 end
function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation(msg_type, data) if msg_type ~= GMCP then return end local pkg, body = string.match(data, "^([%w%._]+)%s*(.*)$") if not pkg then return end local handler = handlers[string.lower(pkg)] if not handler then return end local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, body) if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return end handler(decoded) got_data = true redraw() end
